_readme: Plan3 phase0 plaza research. Extracted from plateau_data/disneyland_osm.json (same origin/axes: origin 35.6267N 139.8851E, +x east, +y north, metres). Contains every way whose point-centroid and every poi (node) that falls inside the bbox below, covering World Bazaar's plaza exit to the Cinderella Castle gate. target_nodes gives the ids named in the plan3 phase0 brief for quick lookup.
